7199b5df65c1b688e28c.headline: I-South Africa ilila ngokukhothama kwePhini likaMengameli wakudala uPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka
7199b5df65c1b688e28c.dek: Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka ushone ngoLwesihlanu eneminyaka engu-71; iNyuvesi yaseGoli nabaphathi bezombangazwe bathume imiyalezo yenduduzo.
7199b5df65c1b688e28c.why: INyuvesi yaseGoli kufanele ibhekane nokulahlekelwa ngushansela wayo, kanti i-ANC ixhumana nomndeni wakhe ngezinhlelo zomngcwabo.
paragraphs: UPhumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka, obeyiphini likamengameli wokuqala wesifazane eNingizimu Afrika, ushone ngoLwesihlanu eneminyaka engu-71 yobudala. Wake waba ngumphatiswa wemayini namandla kanye nephini likangqongqoshe wezohwebo nezimboni ngaphambi kokumela iNingizimu Afrika eZizweni Zihlangene njengenhloko ye-UN Women.

INyuvesi yaseGoli, obeyishansela kuyo, ithe ulwazi lwakhe lobuholi nokuzibophezela kwakhe kwezemfundo kuyohlala kukhunjulwa esikhungweni. I-ANC ithe izosebenzelana nomndeni wakhe ngezinto ezithinta ukuxhumana nezinhlelo ezizayo; umndeni ucele ukuba uyekwe uwedwa ngokwemvelo, kusho iHhovisi likaMengameli.

UMlambo-Ngcuka waqokwa njengephini likamengameli ngo-2005 futhi waba ngumqondisi ophethe we-UN Women kanye nephini likanobhala jikelele weZizwe Zihlangene. Wake wahola nekomidi lezisebenzi zikahulumeni ekuphathweni kokuqala kwangemva kuka-1994 futhi abamba iqhaza ekubhalweni koMthethosisekelo wentando yeningi waseNingizimu Afrika.

bbc322cf208c14e9f811.headline: I-Indalo ihlela ukwakha eKapa ngezigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.5 zamarandi
bbc322cf208c14e9f811.dek: ISthirtyFour18 izoba namahhotela anezinkanyezi ezinhlanu, ama-athikili angu-101 kanye namahhovisi, kanti ukwakha kuhlelwe ukuba kuqale ngo-Ephreli 2027 uma sekuvunyelwe.
bbc322cf208c14e9f811.why: Ukwakhiwa kwalesi sakhiwo kulindeleke ukuthi kudale imisebenzi efika ku-2 500, kulandele imisebenzi engu-400 yaphakade uma sesivulwe.
paragraphs: I-Indalo Hotels and Leisure Group kanye nabalingani bayo bokuthuthukisa bahlela iphrojekthi yokusebenzela izinjongo eziningi ebiza izigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezingu-2.5 zamarandi enezitezi ezingu-35 emgwaqweni iHeerengracht eForeshore eKapa. IThirtyFour18 kuhlelwe ukuthi iqale ukwakhiwa ngo-Ephreli 2027, uma zonke izimvume sezikhishiwe, futhi kuthathe iminyaka emine ukuyakha.

Lesi siza esingamamitha-skwele angu-1 680 simi ngaphambi kwe-CTICC 2, isakhiwo sesibili sesikhungo semihlangano samazwe ngamazwe eKapa. Le phrojekthi izandisa ihhotela elinezinkanyezi ezinhlanu, ama-athikili angu-101, amahhovisi asezingeni eliphezulu, izindawo zokudlela nezokuzijabulisa, kanye nebha esophahleni kanye nechibi lokubhukuda. Umsunguli we-Afrirent Holdings uSenzo Tsabedze uthe ukwakhiwa kungadala imisebenzi efika ku-2 500, kanti imisebenzi engu-400 yaphakade kulindeleke ukuthi ibe khona uma isakhiwo sesisebenza.

Izisekelo zalesi sakhiwo kulindeleke ukuthi zidinge izigxobo ezibalelwa ku-90, ngasinye singena phansi emhlabeni ngamamitha angaba ngama-90. IThirtyFour18 kuhlelwe ukuthi yethulwe emphakathini ngoJanuwari 2027, kanti ukuqedwa kwayo kuhloselwe u-Ephreli 2031.

eb41f97bf483586138c4.headline: Imali engenayo yePremier FMCG inyuke ngo-38.8% yafinyelela ku-R14.3 bhiliyoni
eb41f97bf483586138c4.dek: Imiphumela yalo menzi wokudla waseNingizimu Afrika ibandakanya ibhizinisi lakhe lokupheka, kanti izindleko zenzalo zinyuke ngo-17.1% zaba uR139 wezigidi ngemuva kokuthi ithathe izikweletu.
eb41f97bf483586138c4.why: Abanikazi bamasheya bePremier FMCG babhekene nezindleko zenzalo ezingama-R139 wezigidi njengoba inkampani iqondisa imali ekwehliseni izikweletu nasekuxhaseni izindleko zokutshala izimali.
paragraphs: Umenzi wokudla waseNingizimu Afrika iPremier FMCG ubike imali engenayo engu-R14.3 bhiliyoni esikhathini esiphelile mhla ziyi-30 kuMandulo 2026, okuyinyuko ka-38.8% ngemuva kokuthi ukuthengwa kwayo kwe-RFG ngo-Indasa, eyayaziwa ngokuthi yi-Rainbow Food Group, kulethe umkhakha wokupheka ebhizinisini layo. Inzuzo nethe yenyuke ngo-62.1% yafinyelela ku-R1.2 bhiliyoni, kanti inzuzo ngaphambi kwenzalo, intela, ukwehla kwenani lempahla kanye nokukhokhelwa kwayo (EBITDA) yenyuke ngo-51.4% yaba uR2.0 bhiliyoni.

IMillbake, eyenze u-66% wemali engenayo yeqembu, yandise ukuthengisa ngayo ngo-1.3% yafinyelela ku-R9.4 bhiliyoni yize amanani ommbila ehla ngo-20% kanye namandla kakolweni ngo-5%. I-EBITDA yayo yenyuke ngo-23.7% yaba uR1.6 bhiliyoni. Imali engenayo yezimpahla zokudla ibiyi-R4.9 bhiliyoni, kubandakanya nezokupheka, kanti i-EBITDA yayo yafinyelela kuR513 wezigidi, ngenzuzo engu-10.4%.

Izindleko zenzalo zinyuke ngo-17.1% zaba uR139 wezigidi kulandela ukufakwa kwezikweletu ezathathwa kuthengiselwano lwe-RFG. IPremier ithe ukwenziwa kwemali kuzoxhasa izindleko zokutshala izimali, ukwehlistwa kwezikweletu kanye nokuthengwa kabusha kwamasheya okungenzeka; ilindele ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kokusebenza kanye nezinzuzo zokulethwa kwezimpahla zinyuke engxenyeni yesibili yonyaka.

52677648b044f1c8fe25.headline: Uphiko lwesimo sezulu luxwayisa ngeziphepho ngoMgqibelo kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika
52677648b044f1c8fe25.dek: Izexwayiso ze-Yellow Level 2 zihlanganisa izingxenye zezifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanti kunezingozi zikhukhula kanye nengozi enkulu yomlilo ezindaweni ezintathu.
52677648b044f1c8fe25.why: Izakhamizi nabashayeli abasemandleni ezixwayiso babhekene nengozi yezikhukhula emigwaqweni ethintekayo, izindawo eziphansi namabhuloho phakathi neziphepho zangoMgqibelo.
paragraphs: Uphiko lwesimo sezulu saseNingizimu Afrika lukhiphe izexwayiso ze-Yellow Level 2 ngezishingishane ezinzima ngoMgqibelo, mhla ziyi-21 kuLwezi, ezintanyeni zezifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye. Lezi zexwayiso zithinta iFleyistata, enkabeni yeNorth West, KwaZulu-Natal, eningizimu yeGauteng, ingxenye enkulu yeMpumalanga, enkabeni naseningizimu-mpumalanga yeLimpopo, kanye nasezingenyakatho-mpumalanga yeNtshonalanga Koloni.

Lolu phiko luxwayisa ngokuthi imvula eningi, imimoya eyingozi, isichotho kanye nombani omningi kungakhukhula imigwaqo esengozini, izindawo eziphansi namabhuloho. Ingozi enkulu yomlilo ibikezelwe enkabeni nasempumalanga yeNtshonalanga Kapa, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeNtshonalanga Koloni, nakwezinye izingxenye zenkabeni nenyakatho yeNtshonalanga Koloni.

Isibikezelo futhi sikhuluma ngezimo ezishisayo nezimanzi KwaZulu-Natal esempumalanga, uphiko oluthi luzoba olungakhululeki kakhulu. Imvula ehlakazekile kanye nezulu elimqquba kulindeleke kwezinye izingxenye zezwe ngempelasonto.

011166488411f7f3ca40.headline: Inhlangano yamalungelo yaseNingizimu Afrika ifuna kuphenywe ngokuthengiswa kwezikhali eMyanmar
011166488411f7f3ca40.dek: ISouthern Africa Litigation Centre ifuna abashushisi bahlole ukuthunyelwa okugunyaziwe ngesikhathi ibutho lezempi laseMyanmar lenza unyongwana kumaRohingya.
011166488411f7f3ca40.why: Abashushisi baseNingizimu Afrika nabaphenyi bamacala manje babhekene nesicelo sokuhlola ukugunyazwa kwezikhali nokuthunyelwa kwazo eminyakeni emihlanu kusuka ku-2017 kuya ku-2021.
paragraphs: ISouthern Africa Litigation Centre, inhlangano yamalungelo asemthethweni yaseNingizimu Afrika, icele iNational Prosecuting Authority kanye neDirectorate for Priority Crime Investigation ukuthi ziphenye ukugunyazwa nokuthunyelwa kwezikhali zaseNingizimu Afrika eMyanmar kusuka ku-2017 kuya ku-2021. Le nhlangano iphindife ifuna abaphenyi bahlole iNational Conventional Arms Control Committee, umzimba wongqongqoshe nezikhulu eziphezulu ogunyaze lokhu kuthengisa.

Lolu bizo lulandela isinqumo seNkantolo Yezobulungiswa Yamazwe Ngamazwe sangoLwesine, mhla ziyi-19 kuLwezi, sokuthi uhulumeni wezempi waseMyanmar wenza unyongwana esizweni samaRohingya futhi waphula umthethosisekelo wonyongwana. Isinqumo senkantolo kwaba ngesokuqala ukuthola ukuthi umbuso wenze unyongwana, ngokusho kweMail & Guardian.

Inhlangano yezomthetho ithe lesi sinqumo singathinta icala laseNingizimu Afrika elihlukile lonyongwana elibhekene no-Israel enkantolweni, kubandakanya nendlela okuhlaziywa ngayo izibopho zemibuso nobufakazi. Umholi wayo Wezobulungiswa Ngamazwe Ngamazwe, uAtilla Kisla, uthe isinqumo sibhekane nezindaba ezihlobene nalelo cala.
